faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Junior Research Fellow post at NIT Calicut is 31 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow posts at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow position in the NIT Calicut recruitment drive. Interested candidates should check the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Junior Research Fellow posts at NIT Calicut is via Email. Candidates need to send their complete application to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow post at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus 20% HRA per month. This is a contract-based position at NIT Calicut.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech/M.E. with First class and minimum 60% aggregate marks or 6.0 CGPA in ECE, EE, EI, or allied areas, along with GATE/NET qualification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Junior Research Fellow posts at NIT Calicut. The application process is free.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Junior Research Fellow at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Calicut involves an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and qualifications.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow position is Calicut, Kerala, within the National Institute of Technology Calicut campus. It is a government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q9. When is the online interview scheduled for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The online interview for the Junior Research Fellow position is scheduled for 04 September 2026. Candidates are advised to keep this date in mind for their preparation.
